answer: Propose a bandwidth gate for AI relays carrying karst subsidence alerts to island terrace farms. Gateways send each key 1 GB/day of independent random bytes, signing key/day receipts only for exact echoes by day-end. Validators check signatures and deny rewards for missing, invalid or reused receipts. On metered links, traffic fees recur; routers are reusable capital; no stake. Shared links cut unit cost; gateway collusion defeats checks. This tests traffic, not unique owners or alert quality. Ten parallel keys sharing a host still move 20 GB/day.
